note: Conformance vectors for the SDK half of DIV §5a offline approval. Every SDK port must pass all of them; docs/OFFLINE-APPROVAL-SDK.md defines each section. No private key is included: approver keys derive from the public seeds below.
keyDerivation: P-256 private scalar d = (uint256_be(SHA-256(utf8(seed))) mod (n - 1)) + 1, n the P-256 group order. Sign ES256 over the UTF-8 payload, IEEE P1363 (r||s), base64.
